doc.title: James Lincoln Collier interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2007

title: Closing and Hamilton reunion
summary: Thanks, plans to attend the reunion, and goodbyes.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well you’re a good conversationalist too.
And I appreciate your illuminating some things about Hamilton, that was very interesting.
And I hope we see you up there at some point.

Well I don’t know, I don’t have any plans to get up — the problem is that the reunion weekend is always usually the prettiest weekend of the summer, you know, early in June, and I have a place up in the country here where I usually am during half the year, and I hate the idea of getting on the Thruway and driving for four hours to get on up there, but I’ll get up there.
Well I’ll certainly come up for my sixtieth God willing.
Well thanks for your time today.
Well, Monk, thanks very much for having me. I appreciate it. © Fillius Jazz Archive -24-
